name: Pugnacious Hammerskull
oracle_text: Whenever this creature attacks while you don't control another Dinosaur, put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature attacks while you don't control another Dinosaur, put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)

needs.what: the rule 122.1d replacement for stun counters: if a permanent with a stun counter on it would become untapped (untap step, untap op, untap cost, any effect), instead remove one stun counter from it and it stays tapped
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters can place a counter named "stun" and the trigger half is expressible (event "attacks", source self, condition not-exists another Dinosaur you control), but the engine only lists "stun" as a harmful counter for AI/cost ordering; untap_permanent and untap_all in engine/primitives.py untap unconditionally, so the counter would be inert. skip_untap / untap_limit are not counter-driven and do not remove a counter instead, so writing the card now would be an approximation
